item.title: Fabulous Furniture Add-On
item.creator: A30x1
item.description: Make your world fabulous with Fabulous Furniture! Over 250 furniture blocks and variations all with original designs adapted to the vanilla style. Customize your furniture with the Paint Brush, enjoy functional interactive blocks, choose from 16 vanilla colors, and experience visual effects, connectable blocks, special features, and MUCH more!

faqEntries.heading: Can I use Fabulous Furniture in Survival Mode?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Fabulous Furniture is designed for both Survival and Creative Mode. Furniture and tools can be crafted using resources obtained during normal gameplay.

faqEntries.heading: How do I change the color or variant of furniture?
faqEntries.content: Use the Workshop Hammer to cycle through available furniture variants. For compatible furniture, use a Brush filled from a Paint Bucket to apply different colors.

faqEntries.heading: Why are some electronic devices not working?
faqEntries.content: Electronic furniture requires power. Fuel an Energy Generator with Coal, then use the Wrench to link the Generator to compatible Switches and Outlets that power your devices.

faqEntries.heading: Can I actually use the furniture?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Many furniture pieces are functional. You can sit on chairs and couches, store items in cabinets, cook food, use appliances, turn on lights and interact with many other decorations.

faqEntries.heading: Can I use Fabulous Furniture with other Add-Ons?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Fabulous Furniture is designed to work alongside other Add-Ons. However, conflicts may occur if another Add-On modifies the same systems or resources.

faqEntries.heading: Do I need Experimental Features enabled?
faqEntries.content: No. Fabulous Furniture does not require Experimental Features to be enabled and is designed to remain friendly with the vanilla Minecraft experience and achievements.

howToEntries.heading: Craft & Decorate
howToEntries.content: Craft furniture using familiar Minecraft materials such as wood, sticks, wool, iron and more. Place your furniture to decorate your builds, then interact with compatible blocks to discover their functions. Many furniture pieces are available in different wood types and variations.

howToEntries.heading: Customize Your Furniture
howToEntries.content: Use the Workshop Hammer on compatible furniture to cycle through available variants. To add color, fill an empty Brush using a Paint Bucket, then use the Brush on compatible furniture. Brushes can be cleaned in a water-filled Cauldron.

howToEntries.heading: Power Your Home
howToEntries.content: Some electronic furniture requires energy. Craft an Energy Generator and fuel it with Coal. Use the Wrench to select and link the Generator to compatible Switches and Outlets, which can then power connected devices such as TVs and lights.

howToEntries.heading: Cook in Your Kitchen
howToEntries.content: Fabulous Furniture adds functional kitchen appliances and tools. Use the Stove and cookware to prepare different foods, or interact with appliances such as the Fridge, Toaster, Blender and Coffee Machine. Different recipes may require tools such as knives, spatulas and the Wooden Tablespoon.

howToEntries.heading: Store Your Items
howToEntries.content: Cabinets provide functional storage for your builds. Interact once with a cabinet to open its drawer, then interact again to access its storage interface.

howToEntries.heading: Sit & Relax
howToEntries.content: Chairs and couches aren't just decorations! Interact with them to sit down and use Sneak to get back up. Place compatible couches side by side to create larger seating arrangements.
